name: Butter Lettuce Salad with Tuna, Potato, Orange, Avocado & Olives

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
0.68 kg new potatoes
1 ½ lemons
3 oranges
1 small bunch Italian (flat-leaf) parsley
3 avocados
3 heads butter (Boston) lettuce

instructions.primary_message: Quarter potatoes and place in a medium saucepan; cover with hot water (from the tap) and bring to a boil over high heat. Once boiling, reduce heat to medium and cook until fork-tender, 8-10 minutes. Drain and rinse with cold water to cool, then set aside.
Meanwhile, zest and juice lemons into a large bowl; add mayo, oil, maple syrup, salt, and pepper. Whisk to combine the dressing.
instructions.secondary_message:
⅓ cup mayonnaise
2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
1 tbsp pure maple syrup
¾ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Peel, halve, and slice shallots into thin half-moons; add to the bowl with the dressing and toss to coat.
Peel oranges, separate into segments, and roughly chop the flesh; add to the bowl.
Shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add to the bowl.
Roughly chop olives and add to the bowl.
Drain tuna, flake with a fork, and add to the bowl.
instructions.secondary_message: 6 (170 g) cans chunk light tuna in water

instructions.primary_message: Halve and pit avocados; scoop out with a spoon and medium dice the flesh. Add to the bowl.
Chop or tear lettuce into bite-sized pieces, add to the bowl, along with the potatoes, and toss to combine the salad.
To serve, divide salad between plates or bowls and enjoy!
